adjacent_surfaces.authority: name, tag, and namespace mappings over blob identity (alpha/omega iroh-docs namespaces; .iroh-meta/registry.json maps names to namespace IDs). Not a fifth authority: names are mappings, never identity
adjacent_surfaces.design_note: the S2.7-S2.9 design separates MetadataIndex as its own placement surface; in current code it lives inside id-store beside the blob surface, with no separate port

atlas_content_hash.note: no checked-in producer computes Atlas chunk content_hash (slice 9110-R2); it must not be mapped to the blob, event, world, or artifact identity profiles in this report
atlas_content_hash.observed_profile: SHA-256 of exact UTF-8 chunk text, observed on external corpus snapshots (V1 audit, full-row match); a data fact only, not a producer contract

authorities.authority: content-addressed blob bytes and name-to-hash tags
authorities.backing: iroh-blobs FsStore: redb metadata plus blob data files under .iroh-store/; MemStore in memory

identity.established_by: iroh-blobs Hash::new over the exact bytes at import

authorities.authority: signed event log: chains, heads, fork proofs, waiting pool
authorities.backing: one redb database file per store directory; direct redb API use across event_store/

identity.established_by: p2panda Hash::digest committed as payload_hash (with payload size) in the signed event header; verified at ingest before anything is stored

authorities.authority: durable world state: journal replay and installed modules
authorities.backing: append-only journal.jsonl (fsynced per append in the default ack mode) plus modules/<blake3>.wasm; not redb

identity.established_by: the module file name is the BLAKE3 hash of its exact bytes at install; the journal itself is an unhashed append-only log whose replay order is the authority

authorities.authority: pending envelope delivery only; no stored-data authority
authorities.backing: append-only outbox journal file (outbox.jsonl), replayed on open; signed artifact records kept per account chain

identity.established_by: SignedArtifact signing at authoring: the record hash is hex SHA-256 over signed_bytes and the chain links author/seq/prev; legacy bytes are never re-serialized, re-hashed, or re-signed

baseline.method: source inspection at the stated commit; no build, runtime, or deployment verification

non_conflation.rule: each identity profile in this report is a distinct typed commitment; a shared algorithm name (BLAKE3-256, SHA-256) does not make two profiles interchangeable

redb_inventory.note: redb backs two different authorities (blob metadata via iroh-blobs, the event log directly) at two major versions in one lockfile; 'replace redb' is not one migration

usage.mode: direct redb API (Database, TableDefinition) for the event log
redb 4.6.0 as the FsStore metadata backing
resolves redb 3.1.3 and 4.6.0 for namespace/document storage under id-store tags and docs
no redb: journal.jsonl plus module files
